name: Query Fda Adverse Events
description: Query FDA adverse event reports for specific drugs from the OpenFDA database to identify potential safety signals, reaction patterns, and regulatory intelligence.
detailed_description: Query FDA adverse event reports for specific drugs from the OpenFDA database to identify potential safety signals, reaction patterns, and regulatory intelligence.
when_to_use: When you need query fda adverse events analysis

parameters.drug_name: [Required] Name of the drug to query for adverse events (str)
parameters.date_range: [Optional] Optional date range as (start_date, end_date) in YYYY-MM-DD format
parameters.limit: [Optional] Maximum number of results to return (default: 100)
